summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Quick Start Guide (2025 Updated Edition) - Module Library ## Introduction to the Modular Library The Modular Library is a resource library designed to help you quickly utilize and combine clothing items. To access it, right-click on the title on the left side of the page and select "Modular Library." Once opened, you will notice three folders categorized for children, men, and women. ## Navigating the Modular Library Double-click to enter the respective folder. Inside, you will find basic clothing types, including basic shoes, make-up, shirts, jackets, and polo shirts. ### Accessing Basic Sheets To delve deeper, double-click again to open the Basic Sheets. Here, clothing is divided into several large modules, each containing a rich array of items for you to switch between. ## Selecting and Modifying Clothing Once you have selected an item, click on the Modular Library to view all the modules you need. To hide the virtual model, press Shift + A. The Modular Library allows for automatic identification of the sewing relationships between modules. Display the sewing line by pressing B, which will show the automatically created sewing line. ### Simulating Clothing Using the clothing created by the Modular Library, you can quickly simulate and create a piece of metal clothing. You can modify clothing freely, combining it with other items as desired. ## Switching Items When you double-click to switch a particular item, the previously selected item will be replaced and disappear from the scene. It is crucial to save each piece of clothing in a timely manner to protect the safety of your files. ## Adjusting Clothing Effects To avoid having too many clothing pieces in the scene, some panels will be manually replaced. Continue to modify the clothing effects on the created basic clothing. For example, you can change the sleeves of a skirt to medium sleeves. ### Finalizing Modifications After achieving a satisfactory effect, click on the plus sign in the designated column. Press Shift, select the two sleeves, and press Enter to confirm. Confirm the panel and the sewing relationship; this self-defined part will be successfully stored for future use. ## Creating New Categories You can create various self-defined parts and styles using the small plus signs located in the upper right corner of each layer. Press the upper label to return to the previous layer. Each layer can be created through the small plus sign to establish a specific classification folder. ### Adding to the Module Library For instance, if you have created a set of women's hanbok and want to add it to the module library, start by navigating to the Women folder. Click on the small plus sign to create a new category named Hanbok. 1. Enter the Hanbok category. 2. Click on the small plus sign to add a style named Hanbok 1. 3. Select Hanbok 1 and click on the small plus sign to add the required part types, such as front, back, sleeves, and collar. ## Tips for Adding Parts ### Tip 1: Understanding Reglan Reglan refers to clothing with a shoulder-in-shoulder style. Due to the unique sewing relationship, it is often challenging to identify and create a sewing line with most clothes. Therefore, if you do not have a shirt with a shoulder-in-shoulder style, do not choose Reglan. ### Tip 2: Finalizing Part Addition After adding all necessary parts, click on the small star next to the top of the small plus sign to automatically model and label each part. Check for any mistakes in identification, and click on the small Families to add part effects and confirm. ## Finalizing the Hanfu To finalize, click on the small Sachein and type the part image. Use Shift + Stupid to add paper for multiple body parts (e.g., size 170) and confirm by pressing the Enter key. After confirming all parts, click on Add. You will see that this Hanfu is stored in a patterned way, enabling quick access to all its parts. ## Conclusion You can continue to add various styles to create your own patterned resource library. Remember, in addition to the extra-partition embroidery style mentioned earlier, most parts can be cross-styled and automatically create a sewing line. Use your imagination to create various interesting fashion combinations. See you in the next video! Bye bye. ```
